output.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, the conclusion remains CONTRADICTED. 

H1 (constant currency): The evidence shows that while Netflix does report constant currency revenue figures, the regional constant currency growth rates (11%, 9%, 12%, and varying percentages by region per E11) do not indicate an overall constant currency growth rate exceeding 15%. The reported change remains 12% as stated.

H2 (restatement): No evidence of any restatement or correction of Q3 2025 or Q3 2026 revenue figures was found in the retrieved evidence.

H3 (rounding): The numeric check confirms the actual YoY growth rate is 0.11849 (11.849%), which rounds to 12%. This is definitively less than 15%, not "closer to or above 15%."

The claim states revenues increased by "more than 15%" year over year, but the evidence clearly shows a 12% increase ($12,874,176 thousand in Q3 2026 vs. $11,510,307 thousand in Q3 2025). The actual growth rate of approximately 11.85% is materially less than the claimed threshold of more than 15%.
